decisive_items: SARS-CoV-2 antigen test positive (>5000 pg/mL) from oropharyngeal swab
Histology showed diffuse contraction band necrosis with several lymphocytes in cardiac muscle
No coronary artery sclerosis or stenosis was observed
response.rationale: Acute coronary syndrome is excluded by the explicit absence of coronary artery sclerosis/stenosis. Myocarditis is supported by lymphocytic infiltration and cardiac injury, but the positive SARS-CoV-2 test and elevated inflammatory cytokines make COVID-19-associated myocarditis the most specific and likely diagnosis.

rejected.why: ST elevation and elevated cardiac markers are present, but the explicit lack of coronary artery sclerosis/stenosis contradicts acute coronary syndrome.
Myocarditis is otherwise consistent, but R1 is the more precise diagnosis given confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection and elevated inflammatory cytokines.
